decision.title: The Android build: two API 24 fallbacks, NDK presets, build and fetch scripts (packet , paused)
decision.summary: The Android build adds API 24 fallbacks for aligned_alloc and timespec_get, four NDK presets, tools/build-android.sh and tools/fetch-binding-toolchains.sh, with device runs left to the owner's machine.

body.p: , after , , , . The work stopped at , after the code was committed (fb76abe). bindings/kotlin/DESIGN.md has the resume plan.

item.p: Fallbacks, one branch each, next to the _WIN32 branch:
src/allocator.c: below __ANDROID_API__ 28, the over-aligned case uses posix_memalign instead of aligned_alloc. free releases both.
src/processor.c: one helper, sxml_platform_utc_time, reads the clock. Below API 29 it uses clock_gettime(CLOCK_REALTIME) instead of timespec_get (C17 7.27.2.5).
Both are checked by the undefined symbols of the arm64 object files. docs/C_GUIDELINES.md has the platform note.

Presets: android-arm64-v8a, android-armeabi-v7a, android-x86_64 and android-x86. The toolchain is $env{ANDROID_NDK_HOME}/build/cmake/android.toolchain.cmake, at android-24, MinSizeRel. Each has a configure preset and a build preset, and no test preset: nothing runs.
tools/build-android.sh [DIR] [ABI...] builds every target per ABI: the library, the unit tests (built, not run), the apps and libsxml_kotlin.so. It then:
fails when a 64-bit library's LOAD alignment is not 0x4000;
fails when the library exports anything but Java_* and JNI_OnLoad;
writes DIR/sizes.txt.

tools/fetch-binding-toolchains.sh DIR TOOL... fetches ndk (r28c), android-sdk (cmdline-tools 13114758, platform 35, build-tools 35.0.0), kotlin (2.2.20) and swift (6.2, Ubuntu 24.04). Each download is checked against a SHA-256 sum. Tested here: ndk, android-sdk and kotlin. The Swift sum was taken from a streamed download; the archive was not unpacked.
Results (NDK r28c, -Werror, 568 targets per ABI). libsxml_kotlin.so sizes, stripped / gzip -9:

These are within the proposed budget for arm64-v8a (9,000,000 / 2,400,000). They are below the probe's numbers, which measured libsxml.so with the JavaScript shim. Needed libraries: libc, libm and libdl.
Not done here: devices. There is no /dev/kvm, and ARM images do not run on x86 hosts. Emulator and device runs need the owner's machine or CI with KVM (6.6, 6.10).
Open:
's ctest android/build has no owner (proposed: 6.6).
SXML_BUILD_KOTLIN, named in 6.6's text, does not exist. sxml_kotlin is built whenever ANDROID is set.
